resources.string: No speech recognition on this phone
Microphone allowed - tap 🎤 on the keyboard again

The Velivo keyboard works in every app. 1) Turn it on in Android settings. 2) Choose it as the keyboard. Hold the space bar to switch keyboards. Swipe across letters to type words (flow), hold a letter for Polish characters.
One word per line. Delete a line to remove a word, paste a list to add many.

TalkBack is on and takes over touch. Use the TalkBack braille keyboard or pause TalkBack.
Braille. Left hand dots 1, 2, 3, right hand 4, 5, 6. Swipe right for space, left to delete. Two fingers down to exit.

Removes what the keyboard learned from your typing (frequent words and word pairs, your corrections, swipe shapes). My words stay.
Learned data cleared – My words kept

One phrase per line. Shortcut: “adr = 5 Long St, Glasgow” – type adr and the phrase shows on the bar. Sentences typed at least twice are added by the keyboard itself (the first time it keeps only a fingerprint, no text). Delete a line to forget a phrase.
What the keyboard may remember – only on this phone, encrypted. Never in password fields or incognito mode.

Morse typing. Left half – dot, right half – dash. Two fingers down – normal keyboard.

Long “aaaa” – confirm (Enter, Send), long “uuuu” – delete a word. For people who cannot speak clearly. The microphone listens only while the keyboard is on screen; nothing is recorded or sent. Best teach the keyboard your own “aaaa” and “uuuu” first.
Now say long and steady: %1$s (3 seconds)
No sound heard – louder and longer
“aaaa” and “uuuu” sound too similar – try more clearly
When typing English: British (colour, realise, centre) or American (color, realize, center) – the keyboard corrects to the chosen one.
The selected text (or everything typed) goes to the translator app you pick on this phone. Velivo does not store it or send it anywhere else.
No text or no translator app (e.g. Google Translate – works offline with downloaded languages)
To leave, swipe down with two fingers once more
